{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Communique #87341.36a''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] report authored by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] for the attention of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. It detailed the Empire's knowledge of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the wake of his actions at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It also included another request that [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] be restrained from killing Herrit's subordinates due to the expenses and time it took to training them.
